sources.title: Zavy's Cinematic Stills - SDXL - v1.0 | Stable Diffusion XL LoRA - Civitai
sources.snippet: This LoRA mimics the essence of a cinematic still. It typically produces a shallow depth of field, particularly when the subject, such as a person, is well-defined in the image. It furthermore offers lower contrast compared to SDXL finetunes (which often nearly burn their images), a distinct color range for shadows, and introduces a subtle haze.
